title: Patient Identification Policy
description: Patients must be correctly identified using at least two identifiers before medication administration, procedures, diagnostic tests, blood transfusion, and clinical interventions.
keywords: patient identification, two identifiers, safety verification

title: Fall Prevention Policy
description: Hospitals must assess patients for fall risk, implement preventive measures, document assessments, and monitor high-risk patients.
keywords: fall risk, prevention, elderly patients, safety

title: Hand Hygiene Policy
description: Healthcare workers must follow hand hygiene practices before and after patient contact and during clinical procedures to reduce healthcare-associated infections.
keywords: hand hygiene, infection prevention, WHO five moments

title: Healthcare Associated Infection Policy
description: Hospitals must monitor, prevent, report, and control healthcare-associated infections through surveillance and infection control practices.

title: Medication Management Policy
description: Medication processes including prescribing, dispensing, storage, administration, and monitoring must follow approved safety procedures.

title: High Alert Medication Policy
description: High-risk medications require additional verification, labeling, storage controls, and monitoring to prevent medication errors.
keywords: high alert medication, double check, medication error

title: Emergency Response Policy
description: Patients with life-threatening conditions must receive immediate assessment, stabilization, and emergency treatment without unnecessary delay.

title: Triage Policy
description: Emergency patients must be prioritized according to clinical severity using standardized triage assessment methods.

title: Radiation Safety Policy
description: Radiology services must follow radiation protection principles including justification, optimization, dose monitoring, and staff safety procedures.

title: Imaging Appropriateness Policy
description: Diagnostic imaging should be clinically justified and the appropriate imaging modality should be selected based on patient condition.

title: Contrast Media Safety Policy
description: Patients receiving contrast agents must be screened for allergies, kidney function risks, and previous adverse reactions before imaging procedures.

title: Surgical Safety Checklist Policy
description: Surgical procedures must follow pre-operative verification, site marking, anesthesia safety checks, and surgical time-out procedures.
keywords: WHO surgical checklist, time out, surgery safety

title: Patient Consent Policy
description: Patients must provide informed consent before procedures after receiving adequate information regarding risks, benefits, and alternatives.

title: Patient Privacy and Confidentiality Policy
description: Patient information must be protected and accessed only by authorized healthcare personnel.

title: Clinical Documentation Policy
description: Healthcare professionals must maintain accurate, complete, timely, and confidential patient records.

title: Electronic Medical Record Policy
description: Electronic health records must be maintained securely with proper access control, authentication, and audit monitoring.

title: Patient Discharge Planning Policy
description: Patients must receive discharge instructions, medication information, follow-up plans, and education before leaving the hospital.

title: Clinical Audit Policy
description: Hospitals must perform periodic clinical audits to evaluate quality, safety, outcomes, and compliance with standards.

title: Occupational Health Policy
description: Healthcare workers must receive protection, vaccination guidance, exposure management, and workplace safety support.

title: Blood Safety Policy
description: Blood components must be collected, stored, verified, administered, and monitored according to transfusion safety procedures.

title: Insurance Verification Policy
description: Patient insurance eligibility and coverage must be verified before planned services, admissions, and procedures.

title: Insurance Preauthorization Policy
description: Procedures requiring insurer approval must receive authorization before scheduled treatment whenever applicable.

title: Medical Billing Policy
description: Hospital billing must accurately represent services provided and include appropriate clinical documentation support.

title: Incident Reporting Policy
description: Healthcare workers must report adverse events, near misses, medication errors, and safety incidents for review and improvement.
keywords: incident reporting, adverse events, patient safety

title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Policy
description: Healthcare information systems must protect patient data through secure access, monitoring, and data protection controls.
